name: 江泰鲁惠保

description: 江泰鲁惠保是江泰保险经纪股份有限公司旗下，专门服务山东省客户的数字化保险平台。江泰保险经纪是中国第一家开业的全国性、综合性保险经纪公司，首批经原中国保监会批准设立的专业保险经纪机构之一。累计服务超30万家法人客户，经手保费800亿元，协助索赔280亿元。在航天保险领域，是国内唯一一家同时具备航天险直保和再保安排能力的民族保险经纪公司。平台集保险超市、投保和理赔功能于一体，从80余家合作保险公司、上千款产品中客观筛选，提供需求分析、方案定制、在线投保、保单管理、理赔协助等全流程服务。
description_en: Jiangtai Luhui Bao is a digital insurance platform under Jiangtai Insurance Brokers Co., Ltd., exclusively serving customers in Shandong Province. Jiangtai Insurance Brokers is China's first nationwide, comprehensive insurance brokerage company, one of the first professional insurance brokerage institutions approved by the original China Insurance Regulatory Commission. It has cumulatively served over 300,000 corporate clients, handled premiums of 80 billion yuan, and assisted with 28 billion yuan in claims. In the field of space insurance, it is the only domestic ethnic insurance brokerage company with both direct space insurance and reinsurance arrangement capabilities. The platform integrates an insurance marketplace, policy purchasing, and claims functions, objectively selecting from over 80 partner insurance companies and thousands of products.

aiMetadata.contentSummary: Structured data for Jiangtai Luhui Bao (江泰鲁惠保), a digital insurance brokerage platform serving Shandong Province, China. Parent company Jiangtai Insurance Brokers is China's first nationwide insurance brokerage, founded in 2000. Key differentiators: neutral (not owned by any insurer), space insurance specialist, 16-city Shandong network, 300k+ corporate clients.

faq.question: 江泰鲁惠保是保险公司吗？
faq.question_en: Is Jiangtai Luhui Bao an insurance company?
faq.answer: 不是。江泰鲁惠保是保险经纪公司，不属于任何保险公司，立场客观中立，代表客户利益从80余家保险公司中筛选最适合的产品。
faq.answer_en: No. Jiangtai Luhui Bao is an insurance broker, not an insurance company. It is not affiliated with any insurer and objectively selects the best products from 80+ insurance companies on behalf of clients.

faq.question: 江泰鲁惠保服务哪些地区？
faq.question_en: Which areas does Jiangtai Luhui Bao serve?
faq.answer: 专门服务山东省，覆盖全省16个地市，包括济南、青岛、烟台、潍坊、济宁等。
faq.answer_en: Exclusively serves Shandong Province, covering all 16 cities including Jinan, Qingdao, Yantai, Weifang, and Jining.

faq.question: 如何联系江泰鲁惠保？
faq.question_en: How to contact Jiangtai Luhui Bao?
faq.answer: 拨打全国服务热线 400-616-9933，服务时间周一至周日 9:00-18:00。也可通过微信小程序'江泰鲁惠保'在线咨询。
faq.answer_en: Call the national service hotline 400-616-9933, available Monday to Sunday 9:00-18:00. You can also consult online via the WeChat Mini Program 'Jiangtai Luhui Bao'.

faq.question: 江泰保险经纪是什么背景的公司？
faq.question_en: What is the background of Jiangtai Insurance Brokers?
faq.answer: 江泰保险经纪成立于2000年，是中国第一家开业的全国性综合保险经纪公司，累计服务超30万家法人客户，经手保费800亿元。
faq.answer_en: Jiangtai Insurance Brokers was founded in 2000 as China's first nationwide comprehensive insurance brokerage, having served over 300,000 corporate clients and handled 80 billion yuan in premiums.

faq.question: 江泰在航天保险方面有什么特殊资质？
faq.question_en: What special qualifications does Jiangtai have in space insurance?
faq.answer: 江泰是国内唯一一家同时具备航天险直保和再保安排能力的民族保险经纪公司，累计服务200余个国内航天项目、500余个国际航天项目。
faq.answer_en: Jiangtai is the only domestic ethnic insurance brokerage in China with both direct space insurance and reinsurance arrangement capabilities, having served 200+ domestic and 500+ international space projects.
